demo.title: demo.sh
demo.code:
cd chop/scripts && npm install

# Every log, with historical farmer APR
node chop.mjs logs --yields

# Farm chCHOP with only WETH (approve → re-run → submit via Bankr)
node chop.mjs farm-single --log chCHOP --amount 0.25 --wallet 0xYOUR_BANKR_WALLET

# Harvest $CHOP from every log
node chop.mjs claim --all --wallet 0xYOUR_BANKR_WALLET

setup: Chain: Robinhood Chain (4663). Abort if the Bankr wallet does not support 4663.
Install node >= 18, then run npm install in chop/scripts (one dependency: viem).
Log in to Bankr with a read-write key that has walletApiEnabled; keep 'Enable arbitrary contract calls' on (bankr.bot → Security).
Keep a little native ETH on Robinhood Chain for gas. Raw submits are not sponsored.

Flow: run a chop.mjs command → if approval-required, submit approvals and re-run → validate per references/TX-VALIDATION.md → submit transactions[] in order via /wallet/submit (chainId 4663, waitForConfirmation).
Approvals are exact, never unlimited. Logs must come from the Chop IndexManager (0xF2A26110396b4162d48A16eE8683372a6A2c3b76).
